tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the Sketchlib library by keyword, optionally narrowed by author, category, tag, or face-count range. Returns paginated metadata and a preview image URL. has_more reports whether a further page exists; raise offset by limit to fetch it.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Return full metadata for one model, including whether it is downloadable and its preview image URL.

tools.name: download_model
tools.description: Return a signed download URL for a model zip, valid for 1 hour. Consumes one credit. Subscription plans are capped at 100 downloads per day; past that cap the account's credits are used, so a capped subscriber who holds credits is not blocked.
